stem: Lena buys 2 boxes that each contain \((x + 3)\) pens and 4 boxes that each contain \((x - 1)\) pens. The total number of pens she buys is \(ax + b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants. What is the value of \(a + b\)?
solution: Combine like terms: \(6x + 2\), so \(a = 6\), \(b = 2\), and \(a + b = 8\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
p = Poly(expand(2*(x + 3) + 4*(x - 1)), x)
a, b = p.coeff_monomial(x), p.coeff_monomial(1)
assert (a, b) == (6, 2)
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == [a + b]
